predeclaredAnalyticalControl.derivation: For n(y)^2=A+y/L, p_x=n(y) cos theta=sqrt(A) is conserved; starting horizontal at y=0, the differentiable rising branch is y(x)=(x-x0)^2/(4*A*L). At the vertical exit x=1, n sin(theta_in)=(x_exit-x0)/(2*sqrt(A)*L). Refract into explicitly chosen outside n=1 and propagate to x=1.2.
predeclaredAnalyticalControl.claim: A bounded independent continuous-field reference, not an error guarantee for native rays

hypotheses: All baseline step-sweep cases must have a genuine complete pinned native run, zero error/truncation/undefined behavior, exactly one passive detector hit and bounded finite callbacks. Unqualified cases cause test failure, not artificial qualification.
Baseline finest-step error must be lower than coarsest-step error. Per-step errors are recorded even if not strictly monotonic; a claimed certified numerical bound stays null.

Moderate (+/-250 mm) translated fixtures should preserve local detector ordinate within a conservative 0.005 mm tolerance at step 0.01. Near-world translations are recorded separately and never automatically admitted as public evidence.

A pure research preflight refuses arbitrary LaTeX input, unknown fields, non-mm units, non-finite/negative steps, insufficient index-squared positivity, near-boundary sources, and outside world coordinates before any native run.
All exact native inputs are synthetic added facts. No J09 source interpretation, symbolic ray or physical image is certified.
reviewRequirement: No independent review needed for this additive test-only study; any public fixed GRIN family must receive one final focused numerical/physics/integration review.
allowedOutcome: Research success, failed native observation, or unsupported boundary; no result silently upgraded
